subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should first-party OpenClaw docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide, and should it omit turnkey third-party hardware references?
rationale: The canonical issue asks a product-scope question, VISION.md routes plugin and promotional ecosystem material outside core, and this PR adds a new first-party hardware install surface rather than fixing existing docs.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral After Repair
options.body: Merge the guide after source-backed NVIDIA setup guidance is fixed and commercial turnkey hardware references remain omitted.

options.title: Route Jetson Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause the PR and keep Jetson-specific guidance in vendor, community, or ClawHub-adjacent documentation.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Hardware
options.body: Replace the Jetson-specific page with a broader non-promotional dedicated-hardware guide if maintainers want less vendor-specific first-party surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge the guide after source-backed NVIDIA setup guidance is fixed and commercial turnkey hardware references remain omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent VISION and docs-policy history makes this the clearest owner for the first-party docs scope choice.
